reviews.comment:
Estuve en la primer semana de nov. Si bien el lugar 4s lindo, no queda tan cómodo del centro. Pero lo peor son las duchas, el agua fría y poca. Tb el trato de algunos empleados con mal genio (no todos eh) tenia en la habitación cosas rotas, q jamas se preocuparon en reparar.

(Translated by Google)
I stayed there during the first week of November. While the place is nice, it's not very convenient from the center. But the worst part was the showers—the water was cold and there wasn't enough of it. Also, some of the staff were grumpy (not all of them, though). There were broken things in the room that they never bothered to fix.
